notes.subject: Verified Gmail history + current contact - Greeley Arts Picnic
notes.body: Verified Adventure Zone Gmail timeline: 12/20/2023 - Amy emailed Andrea Haring and Celeste McCorvey regarding the July 27-28, 2024 Greeley Arts Picnic and pitched Adventure Zone/Pirate's Rebellion; no reply found to the original thread. 02/26/2024 - Amy followed up/resubmitted the proposal. Andrea Haring replied the same day, thanked Amy, and said Greeley would keep Adventure Zone's contact information should they have a need for inflatables at future summer events. Adventure Zone did not reply after Andrea's answer, so future outreach may appropriately acknowledge the lapse. 07/03/2025 - Amy contacted Aaron Mitchell regarding the July 26-27, 2025 Arts Picnic and pitched Pirate's Rebellion at the then-quoted historical price of $7,000 for 1-5 days; no reply found. No Greeley Arts Picnic / Aaron / Andrea / Celeste correspondence was found for 2026. Current official City information identifies Aaron Mitchell as Special Event Manager and current Arts Picnic contact at Aaron.Mitchell@greeleygov.com and 970-381-3278. Andrea Haring and Celeste McCorvey remain historical relationship contacts, with Andrea specifically noted as the positive February 2024 responder. STATUS: possible / warm historical prospect - not declined and not cold/new. Continue the relationship rather than using a cold introduction. Confirm current Adventure Zone pricing and commercial models before sending any priced proposal; the $7,000 Pirate's Rebellion figure is historical only. First outreach path should be a short warm reconnection to Aaron; use Andrea/Celeste only as a relationship/referral path if Aaron does not engage. Live CRM application of this source-controlled update remains to be verified after runtime access is available because the startup importer may skip when its required token is absent.
